Needs a Tune-Up: A BMW iX Owner’s Take on the My BMW App. The My BMW app encapsulates the innovation one expects from BMW, yet there’s a disconnect when it comes to the practical aspects of everyday use, as observed with my BMW iX. The remote camera function is a highlight, yet basic functionalities like setting a specific charging window are overcomplicated. The necessity to input a departure time to activate charging within economical hours (11am to 2pm) is a glaring oversight. Owners should have the option to schedule charging independently of departure times, without engaging the energy-consuming preconditioning feature.

Similarly, climate control functionality is limited to a binary on/off state without the ability to adjust the temperature through the app – a basic expectation for a vehicle of this calibre.

The electricity tariff feature also shows a lack of foresight, accommodating only two time slots. This doesn’t reflect the complexity of many owners’ electricity plans, which often include multiple rates throughout the day.

In essence, while the app is a step towards the future, it requires refinement to meet the high standards of convenience and luxury that are synonymous with the BMW brand. The user interface needs to evolve to understand and cater to the real-world usage patterns of drivers.

It’s crucial for BMW to address these user experience concerns, prioritising intuitive functionality that complements the sophisticated technology of the BMW iX. Only then will the app not only reflect the innovation of the BMW brand but enhance the overall ownership experience.

First Class App. **BMW i4 App - 5 Stars**

The BMW i4 app offers a seamless and intuitive experience, perfectly complementing the luxurious and high-tech nature of the BMW i4 itself. From the moment you open the app, you’re greeted with a sleek and user-friendly interface that makes managing your vehicle’s features incredibly easy.

One of the standout features is the ability to remotely check the car’s charge status, control charging settings, and even pre-condition the cabin to the perfect temperature. The integration with BMW's ConnectedDrive system ensures that you're always connected to your i4, whether you need to lock or unlock the car, locate it, or monitor its driving data.

The app also provides real-time updates about the vehicle's health, offering detailed insights into tire pressure, battery status, and system diagnostics. Navigation is another highlight, with the app making it simple to send destinations to the car’s GPS for a smooth, uninterrupted drive.

Overall, the BMW i4 app enhances the driving experience by adding convenience, control, and a touch of luxury. It’s a must-have for anyone who owns or is considering purchasing the BMW i4, and it makes managing your car more intuitive and enjoyable than ever before. 5 stars without a doubt!

Where is the EV department of BMW?. As a loyal BMW owner, I purchased a new BMW full EV. BMW really need to spend some time to make this better for EV journey planning. It is currently totally useless. The app just says the destination is out of range. There is no point calling this feature an “itinerary” when all it can do is plan from A to B.

At a minimum, the app needs to provide easy ways to add charging stations along the route. It also needs to use departure time, weather information and provide information about how much to charge, and how to get back home with sufficient charge.

In addition, users should be able to add other destinations along the way and send the whole itinerary to the car. 

This needs to be top priority compared to anything else in this app right now.

Also, this feature is not entirely available in the iDrive system either. So all planing needs to be done manually. I think I need to bring out my paper diary and keep my own planing notes!!!

Edit: Dec 2024. The journey planner is actually helpful now. Can now set multiple stops and see available charge for each leg. App also suggests charging spot, but doesn’t yet allow user to choose where to charge ( despite setting charger preference). Thanks for the update BMW, keep going. Updated from 1 to 3 stars.

Edit April 2026: charging function in app is a huge improvement from 2023. I’m happy to update the review, noting that journey planning function is actually very useful and intuitive in the app. I’ll go with 4 stars as a maximum because of limitations with the charging network itself (e.g. charger availability, condition, etc) which can’t be viewed through the one BMW app. Thank you and well done team!
